login.title: Login
login.usernameDescription: You can use either your username or registered email

register.title: Register
register.usernameDescription: Visible to everyone; used to log in
register.emailDescription: Used for password reset and notifications
register.passwordDescription: Min 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, symbol
register.networkError: Unable to create account. Check your connection and try again.

passwordReset.title: Password reset
passwordReset.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to reset your password.
passwordReset.emailDescription: You will receive a password reset link
passwordReset.success: If the address exists, you will receive an email with instructions shortly.
passwordReset.networkError: Password reset request failed. Please try again.

passwordResetConfirm.title: Set a new password
passwordResetConfirm.description: Enter your new password to complete the reset.
passwordResetConfirm.passwordDescription: At least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol
passwordResetConfirm.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or expired.
passwordResetConfirm.error: Unable to complete the password reset.
passwordResetConfirm.networkError: Password reset failed. Please try again.

passwordChange.title: Change password
passwordChange.description: Update your account password. After the change you will need to log in again.
passwordChange.passwordDescription: At least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol
passwordChange.redirecting: Please log in again with your new password...
passwordChange.networkError: Password change failed. Please try again.

emailVerified.title: Email verified
emailVerified.description: Thanks for confirming your email address. You can now access all Cloistr features.
